unmapped: losses in [0,1]^K chosen arbitrarily by an environment with knowledge of the learner's algorithm; regret is pseudo-regret against best arm in expectation

settings.name_in_paper: MAB, stochastic setting / adversarial regime with a self-bounding constraint (Condition (1)), without uniqueness
unmapped: Adversarial regime with self-bounding constraint: Reg^T >= E[sum_t sum_i Pr(i^t=i) Delta_i] - C; covers i.i.d. and corrupted i.i.d.

settings.definition_quote: we assume that the loss vectors satisfy the following condition: there exists a gap vector $\gap \in [0,1]^{K}$ and a constant $C\geq0$ such that $\Reg^T \geq \E\sbr{ \sum_{t=1}^{T} \sum_{i \in [K]} \Pr\sbr{i^t=i} \gap_i  } - C$

settings.name_in_paper: Decoupled Exploration and Exploitation MAB (DEE-MAB), adversarial setting
unmapped: Decoupled exploration/exploitation: learner suffers loss of exploitation arm i^t but observes only the loss of a separately chosen exploration arm j^t
settings.definition_quote: a variant of MAB where in each round $t$, the learner picks an arm $i^t$ to exploit and an arm $j^t$ to explore, and then suffers the loss $\ell^t_{i^t}$ while observing the feedback $\ell^t_{j^t}$.

source.label: thm:main_tsallis
source.quote: For any $\beta \in (0,1)$, when using the $\beta$-Tsallis entropy regularizer with $\clog = \clogtsa$, $\alpha=\beta$, and $\theta=\sqrt{(1-\beta)/\beta}$, \pref{alg:main_alg} ensures $\Reg^T = \order \Big(\sqrt{\frac{1}{\beta\rbr{1-\beta}}KT\rbr{\log T}^{\ind\cbr{\beta \neq \frac{1}{2}}} }\Big)$ always

results.notes: Note the appendix proof only explicitly derives the sqrt(log T) version; theorem statement claims no log for beta=1/2 (recovers Tsallis-INF).

bound.expression: G_inst*log(T)/(beta_ts*(1 - beta_ts)) + sqrt(C*G_inst*log(T)/(beta_ts*(1 - beta_ts))) + D_U + K**2*sqrt(beta_ts)/(1 - beta_ts)**(3/2) + beta_ts*K*log(T)/(1 - beta_ts)
